utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — before we start, could you tell me exactly what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping an eye on the supply list for the repair drive—just let me know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send you any urgent supply needs I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I can start with the broken chairs and any loose shelves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be perfect, Tess — thank you. If you spot anything else easy to tack on, just add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m still double-checking the details, but I’ll let you know exactly what help we need as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I’m juggling the school schedule, but I can help with the repair drive. What still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think it’s still going okay, but I may have missed the latest changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you still sorting out the latest details for the repair drive? Tell me what’s needed and I’ll see what I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive details—what exactly do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you tell me what we’re short on for the repair drive, and I’ll keep track of the supply list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m on it. I’ll check the boxes and the drop-off spot today, then I’ll let you know so we can sort the timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — thanks for checking both spots. Keep me posted, and I’ll make sure the Sunday community center setup stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, but I’ll let you know exactly what help we need as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details; once I’ve got them, I’ll let you know exactly what help we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got a simple list ready, and we can go through it together. If you’re free, I’d like to start with the hardware store run and then check the donation bins.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but I can help once I know what’s needed. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. If you can help, we could use support gathering tools and sorting requests.
